name: Torchlight picks Holyflame or Shadowstrike 50/50 whatever the stacks (O-24, D-159)
contract: Owner ruling O-24 and mentor D-159: a Torchlight 503662 hit on a target with any Purity 681413 or Wickedness 681523 stack deals one Holyflame 681415 or Shadowstrike 681524 chosen 50/50, whatever the stack types present. A thousand Torchlights on Purity 1 alone (set_aura precondition fixture, caster the hunter; mana set to 500 before each, Torchlight costs 5% of base mana), 1050 ms apart for the 1000 ms global cooldown: the Holyflame count must lie in [440, 560], and the Shadowstrike count too (the stack type does not choose the helper), with Holyflame + Shadowstrike = 1000 (read as the Shadowstrike count relative to the negated Holyflame count, the negation being the hunter's Holyflame count on itself, 0, relative to the Holyflame count). Residual failure probability of a conformant server: Bin(1000, 0.5) outside [440, 560] = 1.28e-4 (the two counts fail together). Schema 2 for the 1000 s of game time the trials need.

steps.label: Holyflame takes 440 to 560 of 1000 Torchlights on Purity alone (50/50)
Purity alone no longer prevents Shadowstrike
A thousand Torchlights cast exactly a thousand helpers (Holyflame + Shadowstrike)
